text:
Liam: Quick ask — we need a social teaser kit + a 1-page benchmark snapshot for the Apr 21 launch (webinar + organic social). Goal: call out latency vs cost improvements, produce 3 platform-sized microcards and 1 hero diagram for the webinar slide. Drafts by Wed EOD, final files by Thu EOD. Also need inbound routing tag so marketing leads get labeled. @Maya can you take this?

Maya: Yep. A few clarifying Qs: 1) Are we locking the numbers to the last benchmark (p95 220ms -> 88ms, cost/token -35%) or should I wait for a fresh CSV? 2) Preferred CTA copy or do you want a couple of options? 3) Can we use an alternate accent color for the sparkline if it improves contrast?

Liam: Use the latest numbers in the benchmarking doc (https://company.figma.com/file/xyz — updated 1759810000). CTA options: "See the benchmark" and "Compare your cost" — please design both. Alternate accent OK as long as it's from the approved palette (see Figma tokens > Accent-2). Inbound tag to apply: benchmark_launch.

Chris: +1 on two copy tracks for A/B: "technical" (latency-first) and "business" (cost-first). Also add a hidden UTM we can append to demo links: utm_source=benchmark_launch&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=apr21

Sofia: Priority: high. Deliverables must include SVG + PNGs + editable Figma page. Also need accessible alt text for each microcard and a 1-page PDF snapshot for sales.

Maya: Timeline check — I can do comps by Wed 10:00 (PST) and final exports by Thu 14:00 (UTC) if copy is locked by Wed 12:00. Export specs I'll follow: 
```
- Microcard sizes: Twitter 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x628, IG story 1080x1920
- Hero diagram: 1920x1080 (16:9)
- Fonts: Inter variable / fallback system UI
- Deliverables: PNG @2x, SVG (clean paths), Figma page + 1-page PDF snapshot
```

DesignBot: Asset request created: ASSET-4832. Request metadata: owner=@Maya, due=2025-04-17T14:00:00Z, tags=[benchmark, social, launch]. Attach your Figma draft link here when ready.

Liam: Great — locking in timeline. Copy due Wed 12:00. @Chris can you drop the two copy variants in this thread?

Chris: On it, posting now.

Chris: Technical copy (short): "Reduce inference p95 from 220ms to 88ms — 60% faster at 35% lower cost."

Chris: Business copy (short): "Speed up customer experiences and cut inference spend — 60% faster, 35% cheaper."

Maya: Got them, thanks. I'll start comps and post Figma links here for quick review. Tagging @design-review for early QA.

DesignBot: Reminder: brand check required — use Inter and Redwood brand colors. See /brand/guidelines for accessibility thresholds (AA) and export tokens.

Sofia: Perfect. Once Maya posts comps, we'll do a quick 15-min review and confirm final copy. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
